capabilities: Browse a review queue of a repository's pull requests and issues
Create issues from repository templates with a Write/Preview editor and @mention autocomplete
Render PR Markdown files and issue/PR comment threads as Markdown with collapsible file diffs
Submit GitHub reviews (Comment, Approve, Request changes) and comment or close items
Expose the open PR/issue to Claude clients via a local read-only stdio MCP server
disambiguation: Not a Git version-control or vault-sync plugin; it works with GitHub issues and pull requests, not commits or vault history.
extras: Desktop-only (reads the vault's git remote). The GitHub token is stored in plaintext in data.json, so don't sync the vault to untrusted locations; GitHub forbids approving your own PR and the Approve option is disabled in that case. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: Built for reading and reviewing Markdown spec / design documents, which render poorly on GitHub's web UI.
problem: Reviewing Markdown spec and design documents on GitHub's web UI renders poorly, and reviewing them means leaving Obsidian.

relations.evidence: an external Claude client (e.g. Claudian or the Claude Code CLI) see the pull request or issue you're viewing
Other Claude clients (e.g. the claude CLI): use Copy config and add the entry to that client
You read and discuss specs in Obsidian's native Markdown, and every action writes straight back to GitHub.

requires.name: Claude client (Claudian or Claude Code CLI)

summary: GitHub integration that lets you read, comment on, and review issues and pull requests inside Obsidian, writing every action back to GitHub.
